issues.where: the crater lake filling the centre of frame 9561
issues.what: the water is one flat dark navy with no depth, no sky reflection, no sun glint and no cloud shadow on it; it reads as a painted hole rather than a lake
issues.fix: give the lake a Fresnel sky reflection, a sun glint, depth falloff to lighter water at the shore and the shadows of the clouds over it

issues.where: the orange shore band round the crater lake (also set-B-08 lower left, set-B-09 right crop)
issues.what: one smooth flat ochre material with no grain, no strata and no wet line; it looks like clay or plastic and stops on a hard edge against both the water and the grey rock
issues.fix: break the band up with rock and sediment texture, add a dark wet edge and a beach or foam line at the water, and blend it into the grey rock

issues.where: the whole land mass, frame 10027 (same in set-B-02 top right, set-B-03 left)
issues.what: the terrain reads as an embossed shaded-relief map: every ridge has the same hard bright side and black side, the same brown on every slope and the same clean, comb-like ridge spacing, so it looks like a height map rather than ground seen from orbit
issues.fix: soften the relief shading for the altitude, vary the material by height and slope (vegetation, scree, sediment, salt), and break the repeated ridge rhythm

issues.where: the sun haze on the right, x 83 to 100%, y 25 to 42% (also set-B-03 right crop)
issues.what: the glare is a flat tan tint laid over the scene, with blotchy dark patches in it that read as flat cards rather than cloud shadows; the land and sea under it lose all detail
issues.fix: make the glare a specular sun glint on the water with a bright core and falloff, and let the clouds and their shadows keep form inside it

issues.where: the open ocean, x 0 to 17%, y 25 to 42% and y 58 to 75% (and over the sea in set-B-01)
issues.what: the small cumulus are bright popcorn dots of near-equal size scattered evenly, with no shadow on the sea and no thickness
issues.fix: vary the cloud sizes and cluster them into streets or fields, and cast their shadows on the water

issues.where: the red patch at the centre right of the land
issues.what: a saturated red stain with branching lines reads as a texture or decal; if it is lava, it lights nothing around it and has no bloom, plume or haze
issues.fix: give it emission with bloom and a fume plume lit from below, or blend it into the ground as mineral colour

issues.where: the clouds over the crater lake, left crop, and set-B-08 top right
issues.what: the clouds are soft blurry blobs with no lit tops or shaded bases and cast no shadow on the dark water below them
issues.fix: light the clouds with a clear sun side and a shadow side, and cast their shadows on the water

issues.where: the coast round the whole island (set-B-03 lower and right crops)
issues.what: one even teal halo of shallow water rings every shore at the same width, with no surf, no sediment plume and no change with depth
issues.fix: vary the shelf width with the seabed, add sediment plumes at river mouths and some surf at exposed coasts

issues.where: a small bright white point on the land, upper left of centre (about x 37%, y 38%)
issues.what: a stray bright dot with no context, like a light or a render fleck
issues.fix: remove it, or explain it with something visible at that spot
